:::writing{variant="email" id="48271" subject="Excited About What’s Possible for Your Med Spa"}
Hi Karla,

Thank you again for taking the time to speak with me today. I genuinely enjoyed getting to know more about you, your practice, and the incredible foundation you’ve already built. Your reputation, client loyalty, and growth over the last three years are seriously impressive, and it’s very clear how much your community trusts you.

After our conversation, I truly believe you are at the exact stage where implementing stronger systems, automation, and team accountability can create a huge shift in both revenue and freedom for you personally.

A few of the biggest opportunities I identified from our call were:

• Creating clear SOPs and KPIs so your team stays productive and consistent, even during cancellations or downtime  
• Implementing structured lead follow-up and automation so potential clients never fall through the cracks  
• Building stronger retention systems and membership structures that clients actually want to stay enrolled in  
• Increasing package sales and recurring revenue through curated offers and financing strategies  
• Giving your staff clear expectations, incentives, scripts, and accountability systems  
• Streamlining your CRM and communication systems so everything works together instead of feeling scattered  
• Expanding referral partnerships and community collaborations to continue growing your visibility organically  

You already have the hardest part established: demand, trust, great reviews, and strong service offerings. Now it’s about tightening the operational side so the business can scale without everything depending entirely on you being present all the time.

I also loved hearing how passionate you are about body contouring, wellness, and helping clients feel confident from the inside out. I think there is a massive opportunity to package your services together in a more intentional way that increases both client experience and lifetime value.

As promised, I’m attaching:
• Your Revenue Leak Audit recap  
• Our Luxora Collective overview / one-pager  
• Additional information about our 90-day Growth Engine program  

I really believe we could help you build the systems, structure, and scalability you’re looking for while still keeping the heart and culture of your business intact.

I’m looking forward to reconnecting Monday at 11 AM CST. In the meantime, if any questions come up at all, feel free to text or email me anytime.

Excited for what’s ahead for you and your team.

Bethany Gifford  
Co-Founder & CEO
